body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The narrow allowlist expansion has matching unit-test coverage, preserves existing negative checks, and has no unresolved findings. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Allows GitHub App installation tokens (`ghs_`) through the shared attachment token check, leaving upload authorization to the endpoint. **Changes:** - Adds installation tokens to the attachment allowlist and updates its explanatory comment. - Updates the uploader unit test to expect installation-token acceptance. - Replaces rejected-token fixtures with refresh tokens, preserving rejection and host-selection checks. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | pkg/​cmd/​pr/​shared/​commentable_test.go | Preserves rejection and host-selection checks for comments. | | pkg/​cmd/​pr/​edit/​edit_test.go | Preserves rejection and host-selection checks for PR editing. | | pkg/​cmd/​pr/​create/​create_test.go | Updates the wrong-host token fixture for PR creation. | | pkg/​cmd/​issue/​edit/​edit_test.go | Updates the wrong-host token fixture for issue editing. | | pkg/​cmd/​issue/​create/​create_test.go | Updates the wrong-host token fixture for issue creation. | | pkg/​cmd/​issue/​artifact/​shared/​shared_test.go | Retains uploader rejection coverage using a refresh token. | | pkg/​cmd/​issue/​artifact/​edit/​edit_test.go | Retains unsupported-token coverage for artifact editing. | | pkg/​cmd/​issue/​artifact/​create/​create_test.go | Retains unsupported-token coverage for artifact creation. | | internal/​attachments/​client.go | Allows installation tokens and clarifies endpoint authorization. | | internal/​attachments/​client_test.go | Expects installation tokens to pass uploader validation. |
Review effort: Balanced
I'm approving and merging this and I'll address @williammartin comments in a follow up PR.
